note: Per-rule review floors for the rule gold. A floor replaces the rule's default lower bound (0.25, or 0.20 for the extended rules); pairs with first-pass p above it are adjudicated. Floors below 0 review every case (rules a review found dense at the bound). Every other rule's floor comes from samples: the 10 unreviewed, unsettled pairs just below the bound (ties included) were adjudicated and their gold rate recorded; a sample above 10% gold was followed by the next 10 below it, until a sample came back at or under 10% or nothing was left.
